rule_text.name: 702.216a
rule_text.rule: Deception is an activated ability that functions only while the card with deception is in a player's hand. “Deception (cost)” means “(cost), Reveal this card from your hand, Return an unblocked attacking creature you control to its owner’s hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.”

rule_text.name: 702.216b
rule_text.rule: The card with deception remains revealed from the time the ability is announced until the ability leaves the stack.

rule_text.name: 702.216c
rule_text.rule: A deception ability may be activated only while a creature on the battlefield is unblocked (after blockers are declared). The creature with deception is put onto the battlefield unblocked. It will be attacking the same player or planeswalker as the creature that was returned to its owner's hand.

rule_text.rule: The card with deception remains revealed from the time the ability is announced until the ability leaves the stack.

rule_text.name: 702.216c
rule_text.rule: A deception ability may be activated only while a creature on the battlefield is unblocked (after blockers are declared). The creature with deception is put onto the battlefield unblocked. It will be attacking the same player or planeswalker as the creature that was returned to its owner's hand.

representative_cards.name: Recruiter of Irregulars
representative_cards.original_text:
Mana cost: {1}{U}{U}
Type: Creature — Human Pirate
Power/Toughness: 3/2
Deception {U} *({U}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)*
Whenever a Pirate or Rogue you control deals combat damage to a player, rediscover a Pirate or Rogue card. *(Look at the top card of your library. You may reveal it and put it into your hand if it's a Pirate or Rogue. Otherwise, put it back or into your graveyard.)*

Whenever a Pirate or Rogue you control deals combat damage to a player, Look at the top card of your library. You may reveal a Pirate or Rogue card from among them and put it into your hand. You may put the rest into your graveyard.
